shortDescription: Day spa in Leesburg, VA for eyebrow threading, custom facials and waxing, inside Salon Lofts at the Village at Leesburg.

kw1: La Sheida Spa is a private day spa in Leesburg, Virginia, now inside Salon Lofts at the Village at Leesburg. Spa director Sheida Jowkar has more than 22 years of skincare experience and over 35 years of eyebrow threading and waxing, and every appointment is one-on-one with a licensed esthetician in a calm, clean studio.
kw2: Eyebrow threading uses a single twisted cotton thread to lift each hair from the root. It's precise enough to shape a brow hair by hair, gentle on sensitive skin, and keeps wax away from the delicate skin around the eyes. It's the service La Sheida Spa is best known for.

A first threading visit is $23 and returning clients pay $20. Threading also covers the upper lip, chin and sideburns, or the full face including brows for $60, and brow tinting and shaping are available on request.
kw3: If you're looking for eyebrow threading in Leesburg, La Sheida Spa is at 1601 Village Market Blvd SE, Suite 100, inside Salon Lofts. Sheida has been threading brows for more than 35 years, and many clients have been coming to her for a decade or longer.
Appointments are unhurried and private, and each brow is shaped to suit your face rather than a template. Book online, call 571-218-0986 or text 571-601-0009.
kw4: La Sheida Spa offers eight 60-minute facials, each adjusted to your skin on the day. Sheida's signature custom facial is built around what your skin needs, and the menu also includes hydrodermabrasion, microdermabrasion, RF skin tightening and needle-free mesotherapy.
There's a teen acne facial for ages 12 and up, a relaxation facial without extractions, and a men's facial. Clients often leave with a simple home routine tailored to their skin.
kw5: Every service at La Sheida Spa is performed by a licensed esthetician, one client at a time. Spa director Sheida Jowkar combines more than two decades of skincare training with 35 years of hands-on threading and waxing experience.
Clients come from across Leesburg and Loudoun County for brows, facials and waxing, and the spa holds a 5.0 rating from more than 160 Google reviews.
kw6: La Sheida Spa provides gentle face and full-body waxing in a private room in Leesburg. Services include eyebrow, lip, chin and full-face waxing, underarms, arms, legs, back and shoulders, and bikini line, French bikini and Brazilian waxing.
Waxing starts at $10, and Brazilian pricing depends on hair density. Body treatments at the spa use organic products.
kw7: Good eyebrow shaping starts with your natural brow line. Sheida maps the shape that suits your face, then removes only what's needed, so brows look clean and defined without looking drawn on.
Shaping can be done with threading or wax and paired with tinting for fuller-looking brows. Regular clients typically return every few weeks to keep the shape.

description: At La Sheida Spa, a private day spa in Leesburg, Virginia, inside Salon Lofts at the Village at Leesburg (1601 Village Market Blvd SE, Suite 100), spa director Sheida Jowkar is a licensed esthetician with more than 22 years of skincare experience and over 35 years of eyebrow threading and waxing. Every appointment is one-on-one, in a calm, private studio.

Clients come to La Sheida Spa for three things: precise eyebrow threading, custom facials and gentle waxing. Because Sheida sees each client herself, treatments are adjusted on the day to your skin and your brows rather than following a fixed script.

Eyebrow Threading:
A single twisted cotton thread lifts each hair from the root, shaping the brow hair by hair without wax near the eyes. Threading is $23 for a first visit and $20 for returning clients. Upper lip and brows are $33, upper lip and chin $22, sideburns $15, and full-face threading including brows $60. Brow tinting and shaping are available on request.

Custom Facials:
Eight 60-minute facials, each tailored to your skin: Sheida's signature custom facial ($160), hydrodermabrasion ($180), microdermabrasion ($155), RF skin tightening ($165), needle-free mesotherapy ($200), a teen acne facial for ages 12 and up ($140), a relaxation facial without extractions ($150) and a men's facial (from $140).

Waxing:
Face and full-body waxing in a private room, from $10. Services include eyebrow, lip, chin and full-face waxing, underarms, arms, legs, back and shoulders, bikini line, French bikini and Brazilian (from $60, depending on hair density). Body treatments use organic products.

Hours and Booking:
Open Monday and Wednesday through Saturday, 10 am to 5:30 pm; closed Tuesday and Sunday. Call 571-218-0986, text 571-601-0009 or book online. La Sheida Spa holds a 5.0 rating from more than 160 Google reviews.
